annotations.title: Chercher des animaux perdus ou trouvés / Search lost and found pets

description: Search Mission Museaux's listings of lost, found and stray pets in France near a town or point, by species, breed, colour, sex, date or words. Use statut trouve_ou_errant for a lost pet, perdu for a found one. Returns up to 25 listings with photo, dates, source and link. Accepts French or English; replies in French, or English with langue "en".

commune.description: French town name or 5-digit postcode (string, 2 to 80 characters), e.g. "Nemours", "77140" or "Chaumont 52" (department number to tell namesakes apart). France only; a place abroad returns no result.

couleur.description: Coat colour in French or English (string, 2 to 60 characters), e.g. "black and white" or "tabby". With a breed, listings whose colour is not stated are kept and flagged.

decalage.description: Number of listings to skip, for paging (whole number, 0 to 500, default 0), e.g. 10 for the second page of 10.

espece.description: Species: chat (cat), chien (dog), oiseau (bird) or autre (rabbit, ferret, tortoise…). cat, kitten, dog or puppy are accepted. Omit for all species.

inclure_race_inconnue.description: With a breed (boolean, default true): also list, in a separate block, same-species animals whose breed is not stated, since found animals are often filed without one. false to leave them out.

jours.description: Only listings from the last N calendar days, Paris time (whole number, 1 to 365, default 60), e.g. 30.

langue.description: Response language: "fr" (French, default) or "en" (English). A request written in English is answered in English even without it.

latitude.description: Latitude of the search centre in decimal degrees (number, -90 to 90), e.g. 48.267. Give it with longitude, instead of commune.

limite.description: Number of listings to return (whole number, 1 to 25, default 10); a larger value is lowered to 25. Use decalage for the next page.

longitude.description: Longitude of the search centre in decimal degrees (number, -180 to 180), e.g. 2.693. Give it with latitude, instead of commune.

perdu_le.description: Date the pet was lost (string, YYYY-MM-DD, not in the future), e.g. "2026-10-06": keeps listings whose event dates from the day before or later. Replaces jours.

race.description: Breed or kind of animal in French or English (string, 2 to 60 characters), e.g. "labrador", "German Shepherd" or "rabbit". A partial name such as "berger" covers every breed containing it; chercher_races lists recognised names.

rayon_km.description: Search radius in km around commune or the coordinates (number, 1 to 100, default 25), e.g. 10 for a cat, 40 for a dog.

sexe.description: Sex: male or femelle (female). Listings of unknown sex are kept and flagged as not stated.

statut.description: Which listings: perdu (lost by their owners), trouve (found and taken in), errant (seen roaming), trouve_ou_errant (what an owner looking for a lost pet should check) or tous (all, default). Synonyms such as lost, missing, found or stray are accepted.

texte.description: Free words or a phrase in French or English (string, up to 120 characters), e.g. "black lab mix red collar". Breed, colour and sex are recognised; other words are searched in the listing text. The answer says how it was understood.

tri.description: Sort order: recent (most recent first, default) or proche (closest to the centre first; needs commune or coordinates).

name: chercher_annonces

couleur.description: Listing colour, translated into the response language when it is in the colour vocabulary, otherwise as written.

criteres_demandes.description: For each criterion of the request (breed, colour, sex, age, gets-on-with), whether the record states it. Empty when no such criterion was asked.

precise.description: true when the record states this criterion (and matches it); false when it does not say, so it is kept as a possible match.

lieu.description: Written place, only when the position is not blurred.

mise_a_jour_le.description: Latest news of the listing (ISO date). In search results: the latest located sighting that moved it, otherwise its publication (same as derniere_nouvelle). voir_annonce also counts its last sighting and status change, so it can be later there.

publiee_le.description: When the record was first published (ISO date): on Mission Museaux, at the original platform for a reprise, or by the association offering the animal. null when unknown.

source.description: Where the record comes from: mission_museaux (published on Mission Museaux), reprise (a listing relayed from another platform, not named; contact goes through the original listing) or association_partenaire (an animal offered by another French association or shelter, not registered on Mission Museaux, whose listing Mission Museaux relays).

mot.description: The word that gave the sex (“chatte”).

sexe.description: The sex noted on the listing.

sexe_lu_dans.description: Where the criterion comes from: a word of texte, or the sexe parameter.

ecartee_par_sexe.description: The closest listing left out by the sex criterion alone (the most recent without a centre), whether or not the answer is empty; ecartees_par_sexe gives how many it leaves out.

ecartees_par_sexe_rayon_km.description: The radius over which ecartees_par_sexe is counted: rayon_km, or the maximum radius (100) when an empty answer was widened; null without a sex criterion or a centre. Only listings of the breed searched for are counted there; race_non_precisee counts its own.

autres.description: The others, to ask for with their department (“Saint-Denis (93)”).

retenue.description: The town used, the most populous (“Saint-Denis (974)”).

homonymes.description: When several towns have exactly the given name and no department tells them apart; null otherwise.

lieu_non_couvert.description: Present when the given town is not a French town: without a requested department, no search took place; Mission Museaux covers France.

raison.description: hors_france: a place abroad (Madrid, London); introuvable: no town of that name.

mise_a_jour_le.description: Latest news of the listing (ISO date). In search results: the latest located sighting that moved it, otherwise its publication (same as derniere_nouvelle). voir_annonce also counts its last sighting and status change, so it can be later there.

plus_proche.description: In an empty answer, the closest listing meeting the same criteria, up to rayon_max_km from the centre, with its dates and source.

ecartees_par_sexe.description: Listings of this block left out by the sex criterion alone, within the same radius.

couleurs_facultatives.description: Colours that rank without excluding (tabby in “ginger tabby”).

noms_cherches.description: For an animal other than a dog or cat (“lapin”, “perruche”), its French and English names, all searched in the listings' breed (“Rabbit”, “Parakeet”); empty otherwise.

race_ecrite.description: The given breed, also searched as written (whole word) in the listings' breed: partial name, breed outside the directory, bird or other animal.
